"Lately, I just can't seem to catch a break. For the past year, I've felt this heavy cloud over me. But then, other times, I feel like I've got endless energy. I don’t feel joy or sadness, just this hollow feeling. It's like my accomplishments don't even register. I remember a horrific car crash I witnessed right after work one night.
